purpose: Review-preservation, source-bound strategic evidence and bounded latency experiment

changes.preservation: Production review v9 removes model-proposed subspans. Code discovers at most three exact locally provable original facts and reuses all binding/admission guards after semantic normalization; parent uncertainty and full Oracle fallback remain.
changes.limitations: Subspan admission intentionally covers only narrow locally checked printed properties and exact complete quotations. General strategic subclaims and dependent references abstain.
changes.mana: Canonical local snapshot-bound Kinnan evidence, exact official rules/ruling dependencies, distinct source and additional mana restrictions/riders. Conditions do not assert available resources or strategic superiority.
changes.resources: Exact fixed activation-mana per draw arithmetic for isolated supported abilities. Mana-symbol requirements, including colorless C, remain separate; energy/taps/life/sacrifices have no exchange rate. No pruning or learned ranking.
changes.wire: After candidate/enrichment packing freezes, share identical scope text and alias repeated evidence/condition reference keys. Whole source identities, offsets and hashes remain reconstructable. Freed bytes do not expand the shortlist.
changes.knowledge: Permission/review workflow with signed content-bound receipts, trusted registry validation, full stored manifests and read-only provenance/content audit.
changes.evaluation: Ten frozen AI-authored development cases; capture-time suite hash required. Missing judgments never earn success. Human independence and expert validation remain absent.
changes.selection_context: Freeze retained IDs/order, whole printed sources and strategic contracts before local evidence lookup. Attach a compact conditional mana projection after compression; optional arithmetic yields space, whole candidate records do not. Skip empty context, expose actual wire inclusion and omissions, keep reviewer evidence complete.

wire_scope: Synthetic offline fixtures only; bytes exclude system/schema. No transport latency or quality gain inferred.
runtime_measurement_status: Pilot and follow-up are both recorded; neither demonstrates a speed gain. Blind AI reviews preferred follow-up explanations overall but both cases remain partial. Actual Kinnan selector omitted shared aid; a final compact positional-wire fix is awaiting live verification.

regression_checks.adversarial_runtime: two rounds; final bounded clearance, 93 focused tests
regression_checks.adversarial_local_preservation: two rounds; final bounded clearance, 91 targeted tests
regression_checks.adversarial_selection_context: final bounded clearance; tiny probes and source inspection

local_preservation_wire.scope: Representative offline request; schema JSON is not measured provider transport or latency. New local proof can discover eligible facts omitted by model.
